Governo.titolo: Convocazione del Consiglio dei Ministri n. 198
Governo.descrizione: Il Consiglio dei Ministri è convocato oggi, mercoledì 18 novembre 2026, alle ore 16 a Palazzo Chigi, per l’esame del seguente ordine del giorno:

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Equal Pay Day: Would you work for free until next year?
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On Equal Pay Day we reaffirm our commitment to make equal pay a reality for every woman and every worker across Europe

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Better protected for your next credit application
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: With the entry into force of a new EU law on consumer credit on 20 November 2026, our level of protection when signing up for a credit agreement increases. Designed to strengthen our rights and help us make informed choices, the EU law now covers loans up to €100,000.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU backs global compact to cut energy bills and emissions from buildings
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the European Union has endorsed the Antalya Compact for Energy Efficient Buildings, an initiative to reduce buildings’ energy intensity - energy consumed per m² - by at least 25% by 2035.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Strategic Orientations 2027–2029 strengthen the radicalisation prevention
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 20 November, the Steering Board on Prevention of Radicalisation endorsed the Strategic Orientations for 2027–2029. Aligned with the ProtectEU Agenda, the Strategic Orientations set a common framework to address evolving terrorist and extremist threats.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: European innovation in biometrics workshop
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: the European Association for Biometrics and the European Commission cohosted a workshop titled ‘Biometrics Under Pressure: Reliable Identity in Complex Operational Environments’. Participants from nearly 20 countries attended the event, where 10 EU-funded technologies and innovations were presented.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission proposes fishing days for western Mediterranean trawlers in 2027 protecting the most vulnerable stocks
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the Commission proposed fishing days for trawlers in the western Mediterranean for 2027. It proposes the highest number of fishing days compatible with the objective to recover the most endangered fish stocks.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission welcomes political agreement to simplify transparency rules for sustainable financial products
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission welcomes yesterday's political agreement by the European Parliament and the Council on the revision of the Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation (SFDR).

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission disburses €7.9 billion to strengthen Ukraine's financial stability and advance reform efforts
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the European Commission has released €7.9 billion to Ukraine to support financing needs and maintain the functioning of the country's public administration, as it continues to defend itself against Russia's war of aggression.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU Customs Authority holds first management board meeting in Lille
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Union Customs Authority (EUCA) held its first management board meeting yesterday in Lille, marking a key milestone in the establishment of the new authority to support the EU's new and modernised Customs Union.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU bans plastic waste exports to non-OECD countries from November 21
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The restrictions will apply until at least 21 May 2029, after which those nations may apply to receive plastic waste from the EU.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU and Montenegro close accession negotiations on taxation and regional policy
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the EU and Montenegro provisionally closed accession negotiations on taxation (chapter 16) and regional policy and coordination of structural instruments (chapter 22).

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Ljubljana and Calvià named  2027 European Capitals of Tourism
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Commission has named Ljubljiana and Calvià as the winners of the 2027 European Capitals of Tourism competitions, recognising their achievements in advancing smart and sustainable tourism.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Statement after Commissioner Hansen’s high-level business mission to Mexico
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The EU and Mexico reaffirm their commitment to strengthening their strategic agri-food partnership and translating the modernised bilateral framework into concrete benefits.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Chatbots are changing how we look for jobs and talent. Are you ready?
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: AI is moving into recruitment across the EU. Here’s how jobseekers and employers are using it.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Negotiations finalised to link EU and UK Emissions Trading Systems
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Negotiations finalised to link EU and UK Emissions Trading Systems

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Fifth EU-Armenia Horizon Europe Joint Research and Innovation Committee meeting
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The meeting reaffirmed Armenia’s efforts and progress in further integrating into the European Research Area (ERA). Both sides acknowledged that Armenia’s participation in Horizon Europe is pivotal to enhance competitiveness and national capacities in research and innovation.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: New EMN-OECD joint inform on drivers and policies to retain global talent
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The latest EMN and OECD joint inform explores how EMN Member and Observer Countries approach the retention of global talent, covering the factors that support or hinder retention and the policies and practices introduced to support longer-term stay. Read more.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission adopts measures to restrict lead gunshot to protect health and environment
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The new rules ban the use and sale of gunshot containing 1% lead or more to protect human health and the environment.

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: In the list of November infringements, there is one energy-related letter of formal notice and one reasoned opinion.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU spending on electricity support measures reached €12 billion, as reliance grows
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Secure electricity supply is key for European citizens and economy. As EU countries increasingly rely on support measures, cooperation and coordination between Member States on these measures is needed to deliver security of supply at the most affordable cost for consumers.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Jordan: EU and EIB back flagship water system providing water for 11 million people from one of the world’s largest desalination plants
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Investment Bank will support the Aqaba–Amman Water Desalination and Conveyance Project with a $400 million project finance loan backed by an EU guarantee, alongside its existing €300 million sovereign loan, a €97 million EU grant and a €30 million Dutch grant, both managed by the EIB.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU and EIB back Medusa to strengthen Mediterranean digital links and connect Jordan’s research community
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: A €11.1 million European Union grant, channelled through the EIB, will support the extension of the Medusa submarine cable system from its Egyptian landing point to Jordan, improving connectivity for research and education.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU and Jordan advance strategic partnership backed by €3 billion to boost investment, create jobs and strengthen regional stability
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and Commissioner for the Mediterranean Dubravka Šuica took part in the EU-Jordan Investment Conference at the Dead Sea. Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU and Jordan launch negotiations for a Sustainable Investment Facilitation Agreement
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, at the EU-Jordan Investment Conference, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and the King of Jordan, Abdullah II bin Al-Hussein, announced the launch of negotiations between the EU and Jordan for a Sustainable Investment Facilitation Agreement (SIFA).

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Co-legislators agree on a targeted amendment to Methane Regulation to ensure supply security amid energy crisis
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: This morning, the European Parliament and Council reached a provisional agreement on the amendment to the EU Methane Regulation to postpone by 2 years the application of certain requirements for natural gas, crude oil and coal importers and EU operators.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: The Centre opens a call for independent stakeholders to join its Stakeholder Platform
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Centre for Democratic Resilience has published a call for expressions of interest, inviting independent stakeholders in the European Union to join its new Stakeholder Platform. The deadline for submitting applications is 17 January 2027.
